_comment: Machine-readable format descriptor for the packed QR payload (spec #52, sub-issue #54, format v2). Single source of truth: tools/gen_format_descriptor.py renders this into a C header consumed identically by the ROM pack adapter (src/pipeline/pack_adapter.c) and the host unpack adapter (tools/pipeline_test), so the two can never disagree on the wire layout. Format v2 (FORMAT_TAG 0x02) makes the payload self-contained (ADR-0001/ADR-0002): it adds CREATED_AT (u32 BE), PUBKEY (32 B x-only), and a length-prefixed per-game TAG (TAG_LEN 0..10, ASCII) ahead of the existing SIG. `id` is never packed -- the companion recomputes it. Total size is fixed at 112 B plus TAG_LEN (112-122 B), which is why TAG is the one variable-length field this descriptor (and its generator) supports: TAG's actual length is only known at runtime from TAG_LEN, so fields after it (SIG) are addressed relative to TAG_LEN rather than at a fixed compile-time offset.
